rachel_pm: Quick huddle. We need a concise upgrade "safety net" doc for Private (VPC/on-prem). Customers ask for minimal blast radius and clear networking expectations.
kevin_eng: Proposal: three networking modes + staged upgrade flow. Keep the default path simplest: single binary installer with sensible defaults. Advanced users can opt into modular packages.
sarah_pd: Field feedback: customers want an explicit maintenance window option and a one-command pause for traffic. Also strong ask for namespace-level rollback (not full cluster wipe).
jordan_netops: Networking modes I prefer we publish: 
- static-egress (customer reserves outbound IPs)
- vpc-peering (route-based peering, no NAT)
- proxy-forwarding (managed proxy in customer net)
Each mode has implications for L7/L4 healthchecks and IP preservation during upgrades.
leo_ops: For upgrades, we should define two safety mechanisms: pre-upgrade snapshot (KV + config) and progressive canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%). If any smoke test fails, auto-revert to snapshot.
maya_support: From support: collect logs + a single diag bundle command pre/post-upgrade. That makes triage <10m. Also include a human-in-loop abort option.
kevin_eng: Implementation sketch:
- Packaging: control-plane package (signed artifact), runtime image (model bundles + runtime), connector (network shim).
- Versioning: semver for packages; model bundles tagged with build+commit.
- Migration hooks: JSON manifest customer can provide to run hooks. Example (for docs):
"{"migration_version":"1.0","pre_hooks":["snapshot_kv","pause_ingress"],"post_hooks":["smoke_infer","reconcile_routes"]}"
All executed under constrained timeout and logged.
sarah_pd: Launch criteria (minimum):
1) Installer (deb/rpm/container) with a --maintenance flag
2) Snapshot + revert script (automated)
3) Network quickstart for each mode with sample firewall rules
4) Smoke tests: inference, auth, and telemetry after upgrade
5) Runbook + diag bundle docs
kevin_eng: Also require package signing and a verification step in installer. No unsigned installs by default.
jordan_netops: Doc detail: for static-egress we need steps to pre-allocate egress IPs and preserve them through node cycling. Include NAT gateway option and example iptables rules.
leo_ops: Rollback SLA: if revert takes >5m alert on-call and mark upgrade failed. We should aim for revert <60s for config-only changes and <2m for KV snapshot restores in small deployments.
maya_support: Add a checklist for pilot customers: contact info, expected downtime, rollback window, diagnostic access.
kevin_eng: Risk notes: KV compatibility across major model jumps is the tricky bit. For minor patch upgrades we avoid cache migration; for major we run migration hooks that can be slow. Need explicit guardrails in defaults to force manual approval for major migrations.
rachel_pm: Prioritization for next quarter: do rolling upgrades + snapshot flow first, then blue/green for customers with load balancer/peering. Field pilots: 4 customers (2 finance, 1 healthcare, 1 platform).
kevin_eng: I'll draft the migration manifest schema and the package split doc. Will include API for hook status and logs. PR by Tue.
leo_ops: I'll build the snapshot/revert prototype and the diag bundle command this sprint.
jordan_netops: I'll write the network quickstart + firewall reconciliation script and examples for common on-prem firewalls.
sarah_pd: I'll coordinate pilot approvals and write the pilot success criteria doc (error budget, latency regression threshold, uptime).
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/private-safety-net-alpha to env:staging at 2024-06-01T22:00:00Z.
rachel_pm: Thanks. We'll reconvene Fri 9am to review the draft runbook and pilot list. Ping here if PR slips. :white_check_mark:
